title: Executable oracles for LLM-generated mechanism simulators: data, code and manuscript
description: Data, code and manuscript sources for the paper "Where and What: Executable Oracles as Acceptance Gates and Repair Feedback for LLM-Generated Mechanism Simulators". Contains the executable oracle, specifications, reference simulators, seeded mutants, simulators generated and repaired by claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5 (plus a generation-only check with deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash), VLM review inputs and replies, feedback texts, raw oracle results, statistics scripts and the LaTeX manuscript. Code: MIT License; data and text: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
